summary.en-US: Let local AI agents work in the Firefox you already use — only in tabs you explicitly share, with user-controlled takeover.

description.en-US: Zamery Browser Companion connects the Firefox you already use to local AI agents through a locally installed Zamery host. You choose exactly which tabs or tab groups to share and which actions to allow. From the toolbar popup you can take control back, resume the agent, reduce access, or stop sharing at any time. The companion keeps the browser session user-owned instead of launching a disposable automation profile. Broad page access is required to inspect and act on the pages you explicitly share. The extension contains no remote advertising, analytics, or telemetry code.

version.approval_notes: The submitted extension files are human-readable source files; there is no minification or bundling step for the WebExtension. The primary data path is Firefox Native Messaging to the locally installed Zamery host. The user must explicitly authorize the current local native-host session before browser control is granted. The manifest declares browsingActivity, websiteContent, and websiteActivity as required data categories. The companion contains no remote advertising, analytics, or telemetry egress. Public privacy policy: https://github.com/maemreyo/zamery-browser/blob/main/PRIVACY.md
